strings.en:
Captain Sayida,  

Now that proper communication and supply channels have been established with the Castoran expedition, Empress Ihn has requisitioned a refresh of jade tech supplies. That jade tech might play any role in overcoming the brutality of Inquest magitech is a point of pride—or rather, those were Lady Joon's words. I've no doubt that Xunlai Jade has their own interest in studying the seers' magical infrastructure in full when this whole Inquest mess is over.  

On a more concerning note, there's been chatter in my circles that the detained "gift" sent back by the alliance's kestrel delegate never made it into MinSec custody. Minister Cho Min of MinSec is considering bringing in some outside assets to investigate, and I may reinforce that notion if I have the chance. Still, it could be some time before they pick up a trail.  

Otherwise, I hope Rytlock and Canach aren't causing you too much trouble; those two always seem to end up in some mess or another when the commander's involved.  

Give them my regards,  
Ambassador Kasmeer Meade
